creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A daemon that dies before its subscription takes its own first snapshot is reported `disconnected` by `muster window --json`, with its panes still listed, while the shell's `BackendHealth` says `stale` for the same daemon.

`Session::follow` seeds the mirror with a snapshot, but the subscription thread's `held_a_session` counts only its own bootstrap. So a connection lost before that calls `mark_disconnected` on a mirror that holds panes, and the seam's `Notice::Stale` handler announces `stale` regardless of what the mirror says.

Minor and rare: it needs a daemon dying within moments of attach. `muster window --watch` and `muster pane wait` treat the two words as one fact (not answering), so nothing is missed; the two words just disagree.

Found by slot 3 of the 2026-09-13 round, as a 1-in-5 flake in its own test (`a_2P5njTPcm`).
title: A daemon that dies right after attach is disconnected to window --json and stale to the shell
